user.title: Remote Push
user.description: Pick the role of this Home Assistant instance. The hub runs on the instance that is reachable from the internet; the agent runs on the instance without a public IP and connects out to the hub.

menu_options.hub: Hub - public instance (add a remote agent)
menu_options.agent: Agent - no public IP (connect to the hub)

hub.title: Add a remote agent
hub.description: Register an agent that will connect to this instance. The agent must use the same agent ID and shared secret.

data_description.agent_id: Short lowercase name, e.g. b. Every mirrored entity id gets the prefix in front of it.
data_description.secret: Any password you choose. It is not the Home Assistant token; both sides must match.
data_description.prefix: Prefix added to every mirrored entity id. Defaults to the agent id plus an underscore.
data_description.include_domains: Comma separated, e.g. sensor, light. Empty means all domains.
data_description.include_entities: If set, only these entities are mirrored.

agent.title: Connect to the hub
agent.description: This instance will open an outbound WebSocket to the hub. No port forwarding is needed here. Use a long-lived access token created on the hub.

data_description.agent_id: Must match the agent ID registered on the hub.
data_description.secret: Must match the shared secret registered on the hub.
data_description.host: Domain name or IP of the hub.
data_description.port: 8123 for a plain Home Assistant, 443 behind a reverse proxy.
data_description.secure: Turn on when the hub is served over HTTPS.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for self-signed certificates while testing.
data_description.token: Long-lived access token of a user on the hub.
data_description.include_domains: Comma separated, e.g. sensor, light. Empty means all domains.
data_description.include_entities: If set, only these entities are pushed.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the hub. Check host, port, TLS settings and that Home Assistant is running there.
error.invalid_auth: The hub rejected the access token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This agent ID is already registered on the hub.
abort.single_instance_allowed: An agent entry already exists. Only one is allowed per instance.

data_description.prefix: Changing the prefix re-creates every mirrored entity id.
data_description.token: Long-lived access token of a user on the hub.
